upstream.note: Source hashes identify the inspected files. The upstream checkout has local changes.

sources.adaptations: Adapted key validation and extracted the StorageLike interface and MemoryStorage fallback for headless execution.
Adapted dirty state flush concepts into an atomic A/B journal with generation counters and checksum verification.
Adapted schema version checks, corruption recovery rules, and preservation of unknown future schema fields.
Adapted event emission into changed-only UI view model subscriptions and sequential event IDs.
Extracted continuous directional axis calculation decoupled from DOM pointer listeners.
Adapted button state edge detection to latch single-tick press commands for fixed simulation ticks.
